title: SourceProfileAdapter
responsibility: Observes registered source operations in supported test runners while preserving call semantics, startup isolation and uninstrumented production builds.

inputs.name: SourceProfileAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Project root and registered unit manifests used to attribute a source file to one unambiguous active owner.

inputs.name: SourceProfileAdapter.transform.source
inputs.description: Original source text to inspect; transformations preserve authored bodies and evaluation count.

inputs.name: SourceProfileAdapter.transform.id
inputs.description: Runner module address, including supported filesystem URLs and query suffixes.

inputs.name: instrumentSource.source
inputs.description: Original source text to inspect; transformations preserve authored bodies and evaluation count.

inputs.name: instrumentSource.path
inputs.description: Source filename used to parse syntax and resolve the owning runtime boundary.

inputs.name: instrumentSource.unit
inputs.description: Registered unit whose exact owned source and runtime target define this observation.

inputs.name: initializationEdits.file
inputs.description: Parsed TypeScript source file whose module initialization can be observed without moving declarations into a callback.

inputs.name: initializationEdits.unit
inputs.description: Registered unit whose exact owned source and runtime target define this observation.

inputs.name: initializationEdits.watch
inputs.description: Unique generated local identifier for the source observer import.

inputs.name: beginSourceScope.boundary
inputs.description: Registered unit, operation name and async boundary metadata; argument values and results are never captured.

inputs.name: watchMethod.owner
inputs.description: Object or prototype whose own method descriptor will be observed.

inputs.name: watchMethod.name
inputs.description: Method property name selected on the supplied owner.

inputs.name: watchMethod.boundary
inputs.description: Registered unit, operation name and async boundary metadata; argument values and results are never captured.

inputs.name: sourceProfilePlugin.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: runnerConfiguration.environment
inputs.description: Runner test configuration context, including the project root; ordinary production builds do not install the observer.

inputs.name: nativeProfilePlugins.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: profileSelection.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: profileEnvironment.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: profileEnvironment.directory
inputs.description: Evidence destination for immutable runtime capture chunks and native preload context.

inputs.name: watchOperation.operation
inputs.description: Actual operation supplied by the caller; one-pass observers preserve its result, receiver, effects and rejection behavior.

inputs.name: watchOperation.boundary
inputs.description: Registered unit, operation name and async boundary metadata; argument values and results are never captured.

outputs.name: SourceProfileAdapter.transform
outputs.description: Instrumented source for one eligible owned module, or null when attribution, syntax or scope is unsupported.

outputs.name: instrumentSource
outputs.description: Source edits that observe supported call or initialization boundaries, or null when none is safe.

outputs.name: initializationEdits
outputs.description: Ordered text edits around a completed module scope, preserving import and export declarations.

outputs.name: beginSourceScope
outputs.description: Idempotent finishing callback; a scope that never completes emits no successful observation.

outputs.name: watchOperation
outputs.description: Proxy preserving the actual receiver, arguments, return value and unsupported promise identity while collecting bounded successful samples.

outputs.name: watchMethod
outputs.description: Installs observation on the selected own method descriptor without changing its public receiver behavior.

outputs.name: flushSourceProfiles
outputs.description: Flushes completed observations as immutable capture chunks without recursively profiling the collector.

outputs.name: sourceProfilePlugin
outputs.description: Test-only runner plugin; it neither rewrites source files nor instruments ordinary production builds.

outputs.name: runnerConfiguration
outputs.description: Vite-loadable configuration containing only the test source observer plugin.

outputs.name: nativeProfilePlugins
outputs.description: Native-startup-safe loader result; collection-only discovery returns no plugins.

outputs.name: profileSelection
outputs.description: Canonical project root, destination and registry, or null outside an eligible evidence run or inside an explicit benchmark boundary.

outputs.name: profileEnvironment
outputs.description: Bounded source-profile context and a deduplicated Bun preload option for native children.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid registry data, unsupported runner bootstrap or unavailable source configuration rejects rather than inventing observations.
